title: Chapter 324 The Protective Shield Was Broken
content:
Chapter 324 The Protective Shield Was Broken

After a night's rest.

Early morning.

The urgent horn sounded again.

Wang Shuo led a team of generals and quickly climbed onto the city wall.

Ayub, who was on duty, rushed over immediately.

"How is the situation?" Wang Shuo asked Ayub while taking out his telescope to observe the enemy's situation.

"Back to the lord, the undead did not attack last night. Just early in the morning, the undead had organized their army and were already showing signs of attacking."

As he spoke, the ordinary undead had already rushed over.

"Prepare to fight."

Wang Shuo handed the intermediate tiger talisman to Li Jianguo and warned: "In this battle, the defense of the city wall will be left to you to command."

He turned to look at the other lords and said seriously: "I hope you all will work together and cooperate with my beloved general to defend this city wall. If anyone disobeys orders, don't blame the ruthless military law."

Wang Shuo probably also understood Sauron's purpose of forming a squad of generals, and he no longer had the ability to command the soldiers on the city wall.

As for the most suitable candidate, Ayub was naturally the one, but Wang Shuo still felt it was a pity to leave such a brave melee general unused.

The general team does not have a fixed defensive area.

Wang Shuo led everyone and immediately rushed to Wengcheng.

Just at this time.

In the distance above the altar, a vision suddenly appeared.

I saw black smoke pillars above the surrounding altars, converging towards the largest altar.

At the same time, the same thing happened across the four city gates.

In the end, the four huge altars sprayed out a thick jet of black death energy and gathered into a ball above the light curtain of Shanhai City.

After a breath, the dead air mass burst out with shocking energy, and the dead air mass was like a sharp sword.

Directly penetrate the light curtain.

It reaches up to the sky and pierces the earth below.

The light curtain disappeared and the defense was broken.

In the center of Shanhai City, an area of hundreds of square meters was directly penetrated by a bottomless black hole.

Zhao Bangde rushed directly to the roof. After a few flashes, he came to the highest roof. Seeing such a scene, he was also horrified.

Everyone in Shanhai City was frightened.

They had never seen such a horrific attack.

Until the undead elite rushed over with roars like ghosts crying and wolves howling.

Some generals came to their senses and shouted: "Defense, defend quickly..."

Outside the east city gate, another monster, even bigger than yesterday's undead giant rhinoceros, appeared. Every step it took made the earth shake.

[Judgment]

[Level: Level 60]

[Attack power: 2000]

[Defense: 2400]

[Health value: 40000]

[Skill: Self-destruction]

[Self-destruction: When impacting, it can self-destruct itself, causing damage equal to its own health x 5 to nearby objects. The harder the collision object, the higher the damage. 】

Wang Shuo's pupils shrank sharply and his breathing became rapid.

"I'm going to fuck you!"

The target of the huge charge is clearly the Dragon Breaking Stone.

Wang Shuo couldn't imagine where these undead people got these things from.

Is this the background of Black Dragon City?

Even though they turned into undead, they still have so many war machines in reserve.

Not waiting for the giant impact to hit the Dragon Broken Stone.

In the distance, there is a giant beast made of dead bones, with undead monsters constantly climbing on its head.

them--

He was actually building a "human ladder".

I saw that the height of the human ladder continued to increase, and soon reached a height of more than 50 meters.

At this time, Wang Shuo unconsciously thought of "Hooking, Three Gus, Four Mysteries and Fives".

What the hell.

The giant beast ran forward quickly, and when it was 40 meters away from the city wall, it seemed to have stumbled, and the human ladder quickly fell towards the city wall.

It is indeed the Pythagorean theorem.

The undead can count, but the city wall cannot withstand it...
